title: Omma Cash
tagline: A wallet your grandma can use to receive your eth global crypto remittances

prizes.title: Best Applications for Emerging Use Cases

prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description:
Boomers don't care about crypto, most of them cannot even use a wallet, they care about receiving the money sent by their peers into their bank accounts.

As well people living in developing countries on a daily budget basis cannot care less about putting their cash into magic internet money, they just look forward to receive their remittances without the costs and waiting time frame they usually wait for this to happen.

What we are building is focused on making non web3 users able to use crypto without them feeling like it, using the one app they are familiar with: Whatsapp.

All of the user experience runs through the whatsapp chat while all the tech and onchain transactions run under the hood, so that users have a seamless experience of sending and receiving money, wether its crypto or FIAT, their call.
how_its_made:
We are using circle's API to develop programmable wallets so that users don't have to create wallets on their own, we build on top of their smart contracts so that users can send USDC to any of the available chains and their CCTP (Cross contract transfer protocol) so that users can choose where to receive their money, wether its crypto or your uncle's FIAT bank account. 

Integrating Blockscout's API to check and verify the on chain transactions and Ape coin for more degen users who want everything on chain.

We expected to create a UX so easy that anyone can deposit, transfer and receive remittances with a seamless experience. For this we are integrating AI on the chat bot for the whatsapp messaging, so that users have a friendly chat experience through the chat to send, bridge and bring money on and off ramp, so that even your Grands can use it.
